title: Which identity verification providers offer global coverage?
summary: Identity verification providers with global coverage: what their country figures count, how eIDs and document checks combine, 10 providers compared.
body_markdown:
*What published country figures count, and how eIDs, bank IDs and document checks combine into coverage across markets.*


Identity verification providers that publish coverage across most of the world's countries include Authologic, Didit, Entrust, IDnow, Persona, Shufti and Veriff. Their figures measure different things. Most count the countries whose identity documents a provider can check, while eIDs, bank IDs and digital identity wallets work only in markets that have such schemes. Global coverage usually combines both, with document checks where no eID exists.
